RPGCharacter.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes a new entity instance by copying the supplied name, hit points, attack power, defense, and level into the corresponding instance attributes and setting experience to 0." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> name </REF>: any "The value to assign to the instance's name attribute."
        <REF> hp </REF>: any "The value to assign to the instance's hp attribute."
        <REF> attack_power </REF>: any "The value to assign to the instance's attack_power attribute."
        <REF> defense </REF>: any "The value to assign to the instance's defense attribute."
        <REF> level </REF>: any "The value to assign to the instance's level attribute; defaults to 1 if not provided."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the supplied name value to self.name. RESULT self.name]
            [COMMAND Assign the supplied hp value to self.hp. RESULT self.hp]
            [COMMAND Assign the supplied attack_power value to self.attack_power. RESULT self.attack_power]
            [COMMAND Assign the supplied defense value to self.defense. RESULT self.defense]
            [COMMAND Assign the supplied level value to self.level, using 1 as the default when no level argument is passed. RESULT self.level]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.exp to the integer constant 0. RESULT self.exp]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
RPGCharacter.attack:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes damage from the attacker's attack power minus the target's defense with a minimum of 1, then deducts the damage from the target's hit points." attack]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The attacking character instance; provides attack_power."
        <REF> other_character </REF>: object "The defending character instance; provides defense and has hp reduced by the resulting damage."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Calculate damage as max(self.attack_power - other_character.defense, 1), enforcing a minimum damage of 1. RESULT damage]
            [COMMAND Subtract damage from other_character.hp. RESULT other_character.hp]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
RPGCharacter.heal:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Increases the object's hp by 10, caps it at a maximum of 100, and returns the updated hp value." heal]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The object on which heal is called; must have an hp attribute."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: int "The updated hp value after adding 10 and applying the maximum cap of 100."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Add 10 to self.hp. RESULT self.hp]
            [COMMAND If self.hp is strictly greater than 100, set self.hp to 100. RESULT self.hp]
            [COMMAND Return the final value of self.hp. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
RPGCharacter.gain_exp:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Processes the given experience amount against self.exp and the current level threshold, performing level-ups whenever the threshold is reached or exceeded and applying any remaining amount that is insufficient for another level-up." gain_exp]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> amount </REF>: number "Amount of experience points to apply; it is decremented by the XP consumed to reach level thresholds and finally set to 0 when all remaining XP has been added to self.exp."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Start a while loop that executes as long as amount is not equal to 0; if amount is initially 0, the method completes without changes. RESULT while_loop]
            [COMMAND Inside the while loop, evaluate whether self.exp + amount is greater than or equal to self.level * 100 to decide whether a level-up is triggered. RESULT level_up_decision]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Inside the while loop, when self.exp + amount >= self.level * 100]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Subtract the exact XP gap to the next level, (self.level * 100 - self.exp), from amount. RESULT amount]
            [COMMAND Call self.level_up() to advance the character's level and adjust the level threshold. RESULT self]
            [COMMAND Continue the while loop with the remaining amount, checking for further level-ups. RESULT while_loop]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Inside the while loop, when self.exp + amount < self.level * 100]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Add the entire remaining amount to self.exp. RESULT self.exp]
            [COMMAND Set amount to 0 so that the while loop condition is no longer satisfied. RESULT amount]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
RPGCharacter.level_up:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "If the character's level is below 100, applies a level-up that increments level, resets experience, and increases HP, attack power, and defense, then returns the resulting stats." level_up]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The character instance with level, exp, hp, attack_power, and defense attributes."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> level_up_return </REF>: tuple of four integers "The updated level, hp, attack_power, and defense values after the method runs."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate whether self.level is strictly less than 100. RESULT level_up_guard]
            [COMMAND If level_up_guard is true, enter the level-up branch. RESULT level_up_branch]
            [COMMAND Within the level-up branch, increment self.level by 1. RESULT self.level]
            [COMMAND Within the level-up branch, reset self.exp to 0. RESULT self.exp]
            [COMMAND Within the level-up branch, increase self.hp by 20. RESULT self.hp]
            [COMMAND Within the level-up branch, increase self.attack_power by 5. RESULT self.attack_power]
            [COMMAND Within the level-up branch, increase self.defense by 5. RESULT self.defense]
            [COMMAND Return the tuple (self.level, self.hp, self.attack_power, self.defense). RESULT level_up_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: level_up_guard is false, meaning self.level is greater than or equal to 100.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip the level-up branch, leaving self.level, self.exp, self.hp, self.attack_power, and self.defense unchanged. RESULT level_up_skipped]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
RPGCharacter.is_alive:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Checks whether the object's current hit points are greater than zero, returning True if alive and False otherwise." is_alive]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The object instance whose hp attribute is read."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: bool "True if self.hp > 0; False otherwise."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read self.hp and compare it with the numeric constant 0 using the greater-than operator; return True if self.hp > 0, otherwise return False. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
